title: When and How Does Muon Precondition? The Role of Structured Gradient Noise
abstract: arXiv:2610.31728v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Muon has become a popular optimizer for large language model training, yet its theoretical foundations remain poorly understood. In this work, we study how gradient noise geometry shapes Muon's preconditioning benefits. We first show, theoretically and empirically, that under the classical isotropic noise assumption, Muon offers no acceleration beyond a rescaling of the learning rate. This motivates us to investigate structured noise arising from mini-batch sampling in associative memory with heterogeneous task frequencies. We establish an exact balancing threshold for two tasks and extend the analysis to multiple tasks, revealing how task coverage and gradient reliability jointly shape learning. Our analysis shows that Muon can soften the dependence on task frequency from linear to square-root, helping balance the learning of frequent and rare tasks. translated_title: Muon 何时以及如何进行预条件处理？结构化梯度噪声的作用
translated_abstract: Muon 已成为大语言模型训练中广受欢迎的优化器，但其理论基础仍鲜为人知。在本工作中，我们研究梯度噪声的几何结构如何塑造 Muon 预条件处理所带来的收益。我们首先在理论和实证上表明，在经典的各向同性噪声假设下，Muon 除了对学习率进行重新缩放之外并不能提供任何加速。这促使我们研究在具有异构任务频率的联想记忆任务中，由小批量采样所产生的结构化噪声。我们为两个任务的情形建立了精确的平衡阈值，并将分析扩展到多个任务，揭示了任务覆盖范围和梯度可靠性如何共同塑造学习过程。我们的分析表明，Muon 能够将对任务频率的依赖从线性关系软化为平方根关系，有助于平衡高频任务与低频任务的学习。我们进一步识别了 SignSGD 中由旋转引起的负迁移现象，而 Muon 可以避免这种负迁移，并且……
tldr: 本文从理论上揭示了 Muon 的预条件收益取决于梯度噪声的结构——在各向同性噪声下 Muon 不带来超越学习率缩放的加速，而在异构任务频率产生的结构化噪声下，Muon 能将对任务频率的依赖从线性降为平方根，从而平衡高低频任务的学习并避免 SignSGD 中由旋转引起的负迁移。
en_tdlr: This paper theoretically shows that Muon's preconditioning benefits depend on the structure of gradient noise: under isotropic noise Muon provides no acceleration beyond learning-rate rescaling, but under structured noise arising from heterogeneous task frequencies, it softens the dependence on task frequency from linear to square-root, balancing the learning of frequent and rare tasks while avoiding rotation-induced negative transfer present in SignSGD.
